# SimplyFPL

> SimplyFPL is a free Fantasy Premier League companion that estimates your overall
> rank live while fixtures are still being played, tracks mini-leagues in real
> time, and predicts player price changes. Live rank is recalculated from
> in-progress fixture data rather than waiting for FPL's own overnight update.

Free to use with no signup — enter your FPL entry (team) id and the live rank
dashboard loads immediately. A Pro tier (€4/month or €25/year) unlocks the price
predictor, transfer planner, season replay and alerting. Data comes from the
official Fantasy Premier League API, cached and served from the edge.

Agents can call SimplyFPL directly over the Model Context Protocol: POST a
JSON-RPC 2.0 message to https://simplyfpl.com/mcp and call `tools/list` to
discover the available tools.

## Pages

- [Live rank dashboard](https://simplyfpl.com/): live overall rank estimate, live points, captain and autosub handling for a single FPL team
- [Mini-leagues](https://simplyfpl.com/leagues): live mini-league standings that update while fixtures are in play
- [Head to head](https://simplyfpl.com/h2h): side-by-side comparison of two FPL managers — captain choice, differentials, live points
- [Price changes](https://simplyfpl.com/prices): predicted overnight FPL price rises and falls, derived from live net-transfer activity
- [Transfer planner](https://simplyfpl.com/planner): plan transfers, chips and captaincy across upcoming gameweeks against fixture difficulty
- [Frank](https://simplyfpl.com/frank): weekly AI-assisted captain, transfer and chip suggestions

## For agents

- [MCP endpoint](https://simplyfpl.com/mcp): JSON-RPC 2.0 over HTTP POST; `initialize`, `tools/list`, `tools/call`. Exposes `get_live_rank(entryId)`.

## Optional

- [Speed comparison](https://simplyfpl.com/vs-livefpl): weekly automated measurement of SimplyFPL against livefpl.net
- [Sitemap](https://simplyfpl.com/sitemap.xml)
